Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.reservoir

Class RecombinationFluidFactory

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.reservoir.RecombinationFluidFactory
All Implemented Interfaces:
VfpFluidFactory
public class RecombinationFluidFactory extends Object implements VfpFluidFactory
Builds the flowing well stream of a VFP coordinate by recombining surface gas, stock-tank liquid and water.

The template fluid fixes the component list, equation of state and mixing rule. The gas fluid is the surface gas composition; the optional liquid fluid is the stock-tank oil or condensate; water is added as the pure component water (the template must contain it) or as an explicit water fluid. Component moles follow from the surface volumes: gas is converted with the ideal-gas molar volume at 15 C and 1.01325 bara, liquid and water with their standard-condition density and molar mass.

Supported rate bases and ratio definitions:

  • GAS: rate is gas Sm3/day; gas ratio OGR is stock-tank liquid Sm3 per Sm3 gas; water ratio WGR is water Sm3 per Sm3 gas.
  • OIL: rate is stock-tank oil Sm3/day; gas ratio GOR/GLR is gas Sm3 per Sm3 oil; water ratio WCT (fraction of liquid, below 1) or WOR (water Sm3 per Sm3 oil).
  • LIQ: rate is oil plus water Sm3/day; gas ratio GOR/GLR is gas Sm3 per Sm3 liquid; water ratio WCT or WOR.

Gas-lift quantity (ALQ, Sm3/day) is added as extra gas of the gas composition in the stream, i.e. it is assumed to enter at the bottom of the modelled section.

      public RecombinationFluidFactory(SystemInterface template, SystemInterface gas, SystemInterface liquid)
      Creates a factory.
      Parameters:
      template - fluid with all components, EOS and mixing rule set; cloned for every stream

    • RecombinationFluidFactory

      public RecombinationFluidFactory(SystemInterface template, SystemInterface gas, SystemInterface liquid, SystemInterface water, double waterDensityKgPerSm3)
      Creates a factory with an explicit water composition.
      Parameters:
      template - fluid with all components, EOS and mixing rule set; cloned for every stream
      gas - surface gas composition
      liquid - stock-tank oil or condensate composition, or null when no liquid is produced
      water - water-phase composition, or null to use the pure component water
      waterDensityKgPerSm3 - standard-condition density of the water phase in kg/m3
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a source fluid has a component that the template lacks
